title: Proof of Cigler's conjecture on $q$-Hoggatt numbers
summary: We prove the nonnegativity and palindromicity of a family of polynomials arising from $q$-Hoggatt numbers. The nonnegativity is derived from Stanley's $(P,ω)$-partition theory through a standard Young tableau formula, while the palindromicity is proved by an involution on rectangular standard Young tableaux. Our result confirms a conjecture of Cigler.
